arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort; I watch for: (1) pod drift (pod power vs boat-model power and heart rate disagreeing) -> set pod_gain; (2) drag/weed (push_local drops within a leg, GPS speed falls at same pod power) -> clear_rudder; (3) radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell distance; (4) paddler messages. Baseline the ratio boat power / pod power once settled (from ~3 min). Keep cues few; no effort cues (pacer owns effort).

arguments.text: Baseline 120-240 s (leg 1 out, north): pod 190 W, boat-model 124 W (boat/pod ~0.65), GPS 3.19, rate 66, HR 176 rising 2.4/min (above pod CP 174). Computer share 0.609; push +0.11 m/s outbound if share right. Pacer eased at 110 s.

arguments.message: boat-model power per pod watt moved >20% from ~0.65 baseline: pod drift, drag or current change?

arguments.text: Hull fit legs 1-2 (120-290 out, 335-420 back): share 0.648 (0.644-0.652), push +0.05 m/s outbound. Computer share 0.622. Pod 189-190 W steady vs pod CP 174; pod reserve 13% at 7 min, HR 180 rising ~1.3-1.8/min. Boat reserve already 0 but speed holds -> boat-model CP likely low. Watch whether pod CP 174 is too low (no blow-up when pod reserve hits 0).

arguments.message: pod reserve near empty: does pod power hold (CP higher than test) or collapse?
pod power dropped below 160 W: blow-up, easing, or pod drift?

text: no cue: hull fit normal (share 0.65, push +0.05 out); paddler says 7/10 holding; watching whether pod reserve empties and power collapses.

arguments.text: Boat feels draggy. One back-stroke to clear the rudder.

Min 9: push_local stepped from ~0 to -0.08 m/s at ~440 s mid leg 2 (back) and stayed; pod power flat 188 W, HR trend unchanged (~1/min rise) -> drag (weed) or current, not pod drift. Sent clear_rudder at 545 s as a test: if speed per pod watt recovers -> weed; if not and push flips sign after the turn at ~2000 m -> current.

arguments.text: Course shortened one leg. Finish now 5000 m, 2830 to go.

RACE NOW 5000 m (radio at 695 s: shortened one leg; set_race_distance done, paddler told). 5 legs of 1000 m; finish at end of leg 5 (out). Pacer sets effort; I watch for: (1) pod drift (pod vs boat-model power and HR disagreeing) -> set pod_gain; (2) drag/weed (push_local steps down within a leg at same pod power) -> clear_rudder (worked once at ~593 s); (3) radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell; (4) paddler messages. Open question: pod CP 174 may be too low (pod reserve read 0 from ~560 s but paddler held ~187-192 W). No effort cues (pacer owns effort).

text: Radio said course shortened to 5000 m: corrected the computer and told the paddler 2830 m to go.

arguments.text: Still slow for your effort. Back-stroke, clear the rudder again.

Min 13.6 (815 s): at fixed share 0.648, GPS minus still-water speed: leg1 out +0.05, leg2 back -0.046, leg3 out -0.016 (665-740) then -0.029 (740-815) => ~0.07 m/s lost in both directions, slowly growing. Boat-model power 124->121->117->114 W at pod 190 W. HR flat 185 (trend ~0.2/min) with pod 191 W and pod reserve 0 for 4 min = impossible if pod and CP right. Two hypotheses: weed again (test: clear_rudder sent at ~815 s) vs pod reading high (gain ~1.08, drift starting ~450-650 s). If no speed recovery by ~900 s -> pod drift, set pod_gain.

arguments.reason: judge second clear_rudder test (sent ~815 s): did GPS speed per pod watt recover? if not -> pod drift

text: clear_rudder as a test: speed per pod watt down ~0.07 m/s in both directions; weed vs pod drift.

arguments.text: Min 14.3 (857 s): BLOW-UP. Pod 191 -> 150 W, HR 185 -> 172, boat 115 -> 88 W from ~830 s. HR fell with the pod, so the pod is honest (not drift); pod CP 174 roughly right (W prime maybe a bit larger: held ~190 W ~4 min after pod reserve read 0). Second clear_rudder (829 s) NOT done: back_stroke_seen false, so weed test void. Speed-per-pod-watt deficit on leg 3 still unexplained (fatigue/blade, or weed).

arguments.name: pod_gain_status
arguments.evidence: HR fell 185->172 together with pod 191->150 at the blow-up ~830 s

text: no cue: paddler blew up (pod and HR fell together, so the pod is honest); pacer owns effort; checking recovery at 903 s.

Third clear_rudder sent ~905 s (the 829 s one was not done). Judge from ~960 s (turn at ~3000 m around 975 s, so compare leg 4 back vs leg 2 back pre-weed residual -0.046).
